verdict.rationale: The evidence clearly documents an official Sentry Python SDK with tracing integrations: AI libraries are auto-instrumented, plus integration options and helpers like set_conversation_id(). The homepage also says users can 'drop in the SDK'. No item explicitly documents an official JavaScript/TypeScript SDK, so only the Python half of the story is evidenced. missing for 10: explicit evidence of an official JS/TS SDK and its tracing instrumentation, independent or hands-on corroboration of instrumenting both languages.

support.subject: As a developer, I can instrument apps in both Python and JS/TS with officially supported SDKs

citations.quote: Supported AI libraries are instrumented automatically when their packages are installed.
To keep other PII on but turn AI content off, set `include_prompts=False` on the integration.
Drop in the [SDK](https://sentry.io/platforms/). No agents to install. No performance surprises.
